title: Roses Are...
overview: Set in Mumbai's red light area, film narrates the journey of a sisterhood between Gita (24) a trans-sex worker and her next-door neighbor Deepali(17). While Gita plans to elope with her lover Ravi (28), Deepali mistakes Ravi's gestures towards her as love but, in reality Ravi has no feelings towards Deepali. Now it's up to Gita to show the truth and make Deepali realize the harsh reality of the world they live in.
